title: amsinckia tessellata var. elegans
intro: Amsinckia tessellata var. elegans, commonly known as Fiddleneck or Western Fiddleneck, is a flowering plant in the borage family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Amsinckia tessellata var. elegans include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as modulating the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
